Questions

Before you book

Do you provide emergency septic service?

Availability varies by day and location. Submit the request and call if sewage is backing up or the area is unsafe.

Can you work from an existing septic plan?

Yes. Share the approved documents during the site review so the scope can follow them.

Do I need to mark utilities first?

Utility marking is an important part of excavation planning. We explain who arranges it before digging begins.

Can you estimate land clearing without seeing the lot?

We can discuss it by phone, but access, slope, vegetation and disposal needs usually require a site visit.
